chunks: It is surely your opponents whose line will come to end.

key_terms.الْأَبْتَرُ: The cut off one (deprived of progeny or honor)

ai.seo_question: Who is described as 'the cut off one' in relation to the Prophet's enemies?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a divine promise of eternal continuity for the Prophet and his Ahl al-Bayt, contrasting with the temporal nature of their opponents. The term 'al-abtar' (cut off) specifically denotes the loss of both progeny and lasting reputation, a fate befalling those who oppose the divine mission. This highlights the theological concept that true immortality lies in the preservation of the Prophet's lineage and teachings.
